page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfg6.16xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 64 dedicated physical cores and 64 vCPUs, utilizing the Intel Xeon 8269CY processor running at a clock speed of 3.1 GHz. With a 1.0 thread-per-core configuration, each vCPU maps directly to a physical core, ensuring dedicated execution resources without hyperthreading overhead.

The instance is equipped with 256.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB of RAM per core. It does not include any local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met through network-attached block storage. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 20 Gbps, facilitating reliable data transfer rates for distributed environments.

Given the dedicated core allocation and 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio, this instance offers a balanced resource profile suitable for workloads requiring consistent CPU performance without resource sharing. It is well-suited for general-purpose enterprise applications, web serving, build systems, and medium-sized database deployments that rely on external storage volumes.
